title: Chapter 1060
text:
A few minutes ago …

Black Star Palace Battlefield …

Evil Convergence descended here, gradually changing the nature of the surrounding space. Purple and green colors spread out, and the range was still slowly expanding.

In the descending area, countless energy tentacles danced wildly. The defense fleet around fired at the tentacles, destroying one after another as if there was no end to it.

In some of the theories that supported the conservation of energy in the universe, the law of conservation of energy operated in multiple dimensions. In many galactic civilizations' experiments, there were examples of energy disappearing or appearing out of thin air. Most of the time, energy was transferred between the main universe and other dimensions, so it appeared as if it happened out of thin air.

There were many forms of the descending of secondary dimensions. The one Traveler used was like using the secondary dimension as a bucket. He made a hole at the bottom and let the water inside spurt out into the main universe, creating an erosion effect.

Traveler did not put in much effort, only making a hole. It was like drilling a hole in a dam. The erosion that followed was the power of the secondary dimension itself, which was beyond the scope of an individual's strength. It was on a completely different level. Therefore, the descending momentum was extremely difficult to stop. Therefore, Black Star Palace's fleet could not quickly solve the problem of the descending of the secondary dimension.

In the center of the battlefield, Ames was fighting fiercely with Traveler. Her powerful force field collided with the energy of Evil Convergence, creating strong aftershocks.

Her force field Esper Ability was good at defense and control. Coupled with her flexible Void talent, although Traveler had the upper hand, he was unable to break through Ames' defense line quickly. However, Ames was not happy.

The Evil Convergence area is his home ground. He has an endless supply of energy and can consume my energy without any worries. A prolonged battle is not good for me.

Ames analyzed the situation in her mind. She had to admit that Traveler did have some skills. He would be able to join the upper echelons of the three Universal Civilizations.

Although she had improved a little in the past twenty years, she was still not strong enough to fight such a strong enemy alone.

"Resistance is meaningless. Losing to me is only a matter of time." As the erosion of Evil Convergence deepened, Traveler's evil aura became stronger and stronger.

Ames turned a deaf ear to him and focused on controlling her force field to deal with the purple and green energy tentacles everywhere.

On the observation deck outside Black Star Palace, the officers all had solemn expressions. With the defensive measures of Black Star Palace, they were not worried about Traveler causing too much damage. However, Ames' situation was not optimistic. They kept ordering more fleets to join the battle.

Yin Ying was expressionless, but his heart was restless. Although the officers of the Black Star Corps did not let him fight, seeing Ames being at a disadvantage, he felt that his chance to perform had arrived.

Right at this moment, a few spaceships with the Black Star Army's insignia appeared at the edge of his vision.

Seeing this, Herlous said, "Let these transport ships go around the battlefield and come back."

These few returning spaceships had already been reported internally. They were marked as transport ships. Everyone's attention was on the battlefield, so they did not pay much attention to them. They only glanced at these few transport ships before looking away. They continued to watch the battle between Ames and Traveler nervously.

However, in the next moment, the radar suddenly rang with an alarm!

"Alert!" "alert" A Beyond Grade A energy source has been detected! "

"What?!"

Many of the officers present were shocked. They quickly looked at the radar and saw that the energy source was in the transport ships.

"Could it be an enemy …" Everyone's expression changed, and they immediately became nervous.

But before they could react, the next scene stunned all the officers present.

Weng!

The familiar death energy surged out from the transport ship like a tsunami. Hella's figure stepped on the waves and flew towards the Black Star Palace.

"Vice Legion Commander Hella!"

"Sister?!"

Everyone was stunned, and Aurora was even more dumbfounded.

Aren't you supposed to be at the front line? Why are you here?

If not for her telepathy, Aurora would have thought that the person in front of her was a fake.

However, the person who was the most confused was Traveler. When he turned around and saw this scene, his wild smile froze on his face.

What the f * ck, why is Hella here?!

His mission was to distract Black Star and help the people attacking Hella restrain Black Star. But Hella had appeared here. Did that mean that the people at the front line were attacking thin air?

Who am I supposed to restrain?

He could not figure it out. In the end, he could only attribute it to Sorokin … Scammer! Unscrupulous seller! False information killed people!

Since Hella had appeared here, there was no point in continuing the mission. He did not want to continue fighting with the Black Star Corps.

Traveler made a quick decision. He immediately gave up on fighting and ran away. Ames would not let him leave just like that. She immediately switched from defense to offense.

Hella glared at Traveler but did not immediately join the battle.

She remembered Han Xiao's order and quickly entered the observation deck. She did not bother with the confused officers and went straight to Yin Ying.

"Put on this mechanical suit. Black Star wants to see you."

"Huh?"

Yin Ying was confused.

"There's no time to explain. Get in."

Hella did not say anything and deactivated the King. The King immediately put on Yin Ying's body.

The next moment, the confused Silver Shadow disappeared from the spot without a trace.

After doing this, Hella finally had time to breathe a sigh of relief.

The officers immediately surrounded her.

"Why are you here? Where's His Excellency Black Star?"

Hardaway asked.

Once he mentioned this, Hella's heart ached. Her face darkened.

The impression she gave to the officers was that she was cold and tough. Now that she showed such a sad expression, the officers were all shocked. They could not help but think of the worst possible scenario.

Could it be that … the Black Star Corps Captain was killed?

"Sister …" Aurora noticed Hella's depressed mood. She could not help but pull her hand with a worried expression.

"I owe him … too much."

Hila closed her eyes and clenched her fists as if she was talking to herself.

"How am I supposed to pay you back for treating me like this …"

…

At this moment, Han Xiao left the devastated frontline stronghold with Yin Ying. The cleaning of the battlefield was left to the players and other warriors. He did not waste any time and planned to find trouble with Gorután while the effects of the Character Summon Card were still in effect.

Hella was attacked, and the information was leaked by Gorután. Although Hella's ability was special and she would have to go through this sooner or later, it did not mean that Han Xiao wanted to let go of Gorután who caused this disaster.

On the way to Gorután's territory, Han Xiao made his request to Yin Ying …

"You want to use my body?"

Yin Ying's face was filled with horror.

He did not understand the effect of the King, and he did not dare ask. He was originally confused as to why he was brought over by Black Star, but after hearing Han Xiao's words, Yin Ying panicked.

So, you're this kind of Black Star! You're actually after my body!

"Although that's what I meant, I feel like you've misunderstood something." Han Xiao's tone was helpless. "I just want you to do me a favor. Treat it as a transaction in exchange for the right to use the Evolution Cube."

"You scared me to death. I thought you wanted to capture me and transform me into a special weapon like the Mecha Empire." Hearing this, Yin Ying heaved a sigh of relief.

"… Oh, that seems to make sense." Han Xiao coughed and changed the topic. "Your body has a hidden characteristic. When you awaken it, you can turn yourself into a special Universal Treasure. I need you to transform. Help me with this."

"How do you know?" Yin Ying was curious. He did not even know about this, so how did an outsider know more about his body than him?

"Do you still remember the first time we met? When we sparred, I controlled your body and conducted a detailed inspection. At that time, I discovered that your body was hiding a secret. It might have mutated when you became a Beyond Grade A." Han Xiao immediately began to use his talent of lying through his teeth.

In fact, he had already poked Yin Ying's interface and seen the skill that had become a Universal Treasure in Yin Ying's skill list.

However, normal characters did not have an interface and could not clearly know all the abilities they had like the players. Yin Ying was in such a situation. He did not know that he had such a skill.

Under such circumstances, as long as he guided him and made him realize this hidden skill, he might be able to use it directly.

"Okay, what should I do?" Yin Ying reluctantly accepted this explanation.

"Try to feel in this direction."

Han Xiao did not have a specific method. In the past, Yin Ying did not think in this direction. Now that he realized this point, he might be able to awaken it directly. It was like a person who had been working out for a long time. If he did not challenge himself, he would not know that he could do many difficult movements.

Yin Ying was skeptical, but he could only try it out. He maintained the idea of becoming a Universal Treasure and controlled his body to slowly change.

His silver body quickly turned into a pool of liquid metal and kept changing shape, searching for the feeling.

After a while, a subtle aura suddenly spread out. Yin Ying took the initiative to climb onto Han Xiao's body. The silver liquid metal wrapped Han Xiao's entire body like a layer of paste, turning him into a silver human body.

"So I really have this ability!" Yin Ying was shocked by himself.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He looked at the notification on the interface and smiled with satisfaction.

"I was right, wasn't I? You do have special potential."

At this moment, the interface showed that Yin Ying had already turned into a Universal Treasure-level equipment. He wore it and shared his amazing defense and speed. At the same time, he also shared many skills. As long as he rode Yin Ying, he could use them.

Furthermore, wearing Yin Ying felt very comfortable. It was like sitting in a luxury car. The seats and interior made Han Xiao feel very comfortable.

On the other side, Yin Ying felt this novel feeling and secretly made a decision.

He had to get closer to Black Star in the future. This guy could easily detect potential that even he did not realize. His eyesight was too terrifying. If he could get Black Star to help him uncover the mysteries of his body, his growth would definitely be much faster.

Having unearthed his hidden potential, Yin Ying was very happy. He did not reject lending his body to Han Xiao and letting him control it.

The two of them worked together for a while, and Han Xiao gradually familiarized himself with the operation of this good car. He loved it very much.

"Let's go, let's go!"

Then, without another word, he started at fifth gear.

Bang!

Yin Ying's acceleration ability was activated, and its speed seemed to increase endlessly. Han Xiao turned into a silver meteor and quickly disappeared into the universe.

…

Somewhere in the Emerald Star Cluster, a teleportation gate quickly formed in space and spat out three figures.

"Phew, we finally made it out."

Sagman's tense nerves finally relaxed. He looked in the direction of the battlefield with a complicated expression, and fear lingered in his heart.

Speaking of which, Black Star's strength was too scary. It was as if he would be captured if he ran a little slower …

Everyone could not help but feel lucky that Black Star was chasing after Radiance and not Ethereal.

He turned around and exchanged glances with Taylor and Mercer. The three of them had the same expression in their eyes.

That was close. We almost entered the palace a second time.

"Your Excellency Kasuyi is so wise to help Black Star deal with Radiance. Not only did you restrain Black Star and prevent him from chasing after us, but you also dealt a blow to Radiance's people. Although the mission failed, Your Excellency Kasuyi still made a contribution," Taylor said.

Thinking of the tragic situation on Radiance's side, the three of them felt great and admired Kasuyi's decision even more.

"It's just that … our Tolaen has been captured by Black Star. He's also a problem." Sagman shook his head.

"Heh, that's nothing. He'll just suffer a little. When he's released, we'll have a common topic to talk about."

"Haha, that makes sense."

Although they had lost a teammate, the three of them did not mind. The atmosphere was cheerful.

On Radiance's side, the atmosphere was the complete opposite. It was filled with gloom.

The Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device brought Radiance's fleet back to the territory. The high official, who had been waiting at the teleportation point to receive Hella, was stunned when he saw the tragic state of his troops.

"Six Beyond Grade As, and only two of you returned?"

Hearing the high official's question, Sierron's expression was extremely ugly.

If they fought head-on without considering the consequences, he was confident that he would be able to fight on par with Black Star in his explosive state. Unfortunately, Pugilists were like a sharp knife. All their strength was concentrated in their bodies. Protecting his teammates was not something he was good at.

Thinking of how they had lost so many Beyond Grade As under his leadership, and how they had been beaten to a pulp by Black Star, Sierron trembled in anger.

This is an absolute humiliation!

This time, the Mecha Empire is definitely going to laugh at us!

The upper echelons will definitely think that my ability to lead is far inferior to the Mecha Empire, so I can only rely on Manison more …

Right, there's also that bastard Kasuyi. If not for him, Radiance would not have suffered such a huge loss.

Sierron clenched his teeth.

Kasuyi, just you wait. The Mecha Empire will definitely find trouble with you!

…

Near a certain stargate station in the Emerald Star Cluster, a fleet was fighting with a mechanical army. The most eye-catching thing on the battlefield was a figure covered in dark brown Pugilist flames. It was Beast Ancestor, Gorután.

His opponents were more than ten Apostle Weapons under the Mecha Empire. They were all of different shapes and sizes, but they were extremely strong. Working together, they were able to fight Gorután back and forth.

Ever since Gorután arrived to rescue the fleet, the two sides had been fighting for a long time.

"Mecha Empire, it's useless even if you stop me!"

Gorután spoke with a deep voice while fighting with the Apostle Weapons.

"Black Star's frontline stronghold was attacked. Hella might have already died in battle. Even if you don't let me destroy the stargate station, the dynasty's reinforcements won't be able to make it in time. In such a situation, Hella will definitely die."

He did not know the exact situation at the scene. His impression was still at the time when Sorokin reported that Hella was in a desperate situation.

Destroying the surrounding stargate stations was just icing on the cake. He still did not think that Hella had any chance of surviving this desperate situation.

Manison ignored him. Only the Apostle Weapons continued to fight with Gorután.

"Are you going to let her go or not?"

Seeing that the Mecha Empire did not respond, Gorután became more and more furious.

Manison still did not respond.

"You really won't give up. Just you wait. The news of Hella's death will arrive very soon. By then, you'll know that everything you're doing now is futile." Gorután was furious.

Manison still did not respond. He only silently intercepted all the information sent to Gorután on the virtual level.

It was not that no one told Gorután what had happened. It was just that he could not receive any information from the outside world!

The Virtual Mechanic's methods were undetectable. Gorután was completely in the dark. He was still immersed in the joy of successfully taking revenge. He only felt that his plan was working.

Gorután was so angry at Manison's attitude of ignoring him that he gritted his teeth. Just as he was about to continue speaking, he suddenly had an intuition. He turned his head and looked into the distance with a puzzled expression.

A silver meteor suddenly entered their field of vision and approached them at an unbelievable speed!

A strange sense of danger suddenly appeared in Gorután's mind.
